source_text: De cantico Debborae. Sisara cum curribus ferreis — victoria in cantico. Gratia post bellum hymnum gignit.
pass_a_gloss: Concerning song of-Deborah. Sisera with chariots iron — victory in song. Grace after war hymn begets.
pass_b_english: On Deborah’s song. [[Sisera with iron chariots >> Bible:Judges 4:3]] — victory becomes song. Grace after war begets a hymn.
notes: True OET; no copyrighted Judges FOTC.
